candidates.explanation: When the DTO has no photo (a PATCH that only changes firstName), `updateUserDto.photo === undefined` sets `photo = null`. The repository update then treats null as 'clear the photo', so the avatar is removed. Only an explicit `photo: null` should clear it. An omitted photo should stay `undefined`, which means 'leave unchanged'. Re-uploading works because the DTO then carries a photo id.

fix.description: Change the branch so only an explicit null clears the photo: `} else if (updateUserDto.photo === null) { photo = null; }`. An omitted photo stays undefined and is left unchanged.
